newsitem.title: USA: AMEX lists Reset PERQS on AMD stock.
newsitem.headline: AMEX lists Reset PERQS on AMD stock.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange has begun trading Morgan Stanley, Dean Witter, Discover & Co Reset Performance Equity-linked Redemption Quarterly-pay Securities (Reset PERQS) exchangeable for Advanced Micro Devices Inc common stock, the exchange said Tuesday.
Trading under ticker symbol, the $60 million offering consists of 1.6 million Reset PERQS issued at $38-5/8 per unit and maturing on April 15, 1999, the exchange said.

"These PERQS offer a quarterly coupon return, as well as the opportunity to participate in the upside potential of Advanced Micro Devices over the term of the note," Richard Mikaliunas, AMEX senior vice president, said in a statement.
The Reset PERQS have quarterly interest payments of 10 percent per annum against the AMD stock price.

If the AMD stock price on April 15, 1998 is below the first-year cap price of $52.15, the PERQS will have an exchange ratio of 1.0 against the stock. If the stock price exceeds that first-year cap, the exchange ratio will be adjusted accordingly.
The value of the AMD stock to be delivered upon maturity will not exceed $70.40 per principal amount of each PERQS, the exchange said.
The specialist unit on the AMEX floor is AIM Securities/Aegis Specialists.
AMD, the semiconductor maker, is not affiliated with the issuer nor involved with this offering in any way, AMEX noted.
At 1100 EDT/1500 GMT, the AMD PERQS was trading at 36-1/2. AMD shares were at 35, down one.
